why: Each changed unit edits its rendered tree by exactly one kind of edit, and lane B's WITNESS carries the patch from the parent's tree to the candidate's (langs/ts/patch.mjs, a keyed diff): Added gains a keyed item (insert), Dropped loses one (remove), Label's text changes (text), Link's href changes (attribute), Reorder swaps two keyed items (move: the keys kept in order stay, the one that left its place moves). Logged renders the same tree and logs another message from its effect: its patch is empty and its summary says the trace differs, so an empty patch never reads as equality. Lane A: the identity guard withholds Added and Dropped (their element shapes differ), the other changed lemmas are not proved, and Untouched's identical text is proved.

Logged.summary: no tree difference; the trace differs
